title: "Captions with their tables"
mdbrand:

A table long enough to break across pages kept its caption and its heading
together at the foot of a page while its rows went over: Typst breaks a
figure between its caption and the first row. Each heading must share its
page with its caption and the first three rows of its table.
And its last row went over alone: the last three rows must share a page.
